description: Persistent repository of ATS autofill failure patterns, root causes, and verified fixes.

lessons.symptom: State machine stuck on Overview or misclassifying Job Overview page as auth_sign_in.
lessons.root_cause: Broad 'button:has-text(Sign In)' selector matched the global navbar 'Sign In' header button on the job overview page before checking for applyButton.
lessons.fix_rule: Prioritize applyButton for 'overview' when password input is absent; strictly target button[data-automation-id='signInSubmitButton'] inside auth container.

lessons.symptom: Combobox selecting transient loading spinner instead of real option.
lessons.root_cause: Async React-Select combobox displays .select__menu-notice--loading while fetching suggestions.

lessons.symptom: Autofill halts after credential entry on Workday.
lessons.root_cause: Workday post-auth redirect lands back on /job/... overview page, requiring an authenticated 'Apply' click before Stage 3 mounts.
lessons.fix_rule: Use state machine loop (max 20 transitions) that handles overview -> modal -> auth -> overview -> info dynamically.

lessons.symptom: Red validation outlines persist after filling inputs.
lessons.root_cause: Setting input value without synthetic event dispatch leaves internal React/Angular state uncommitted.
lessons.fix_rule: Always dispatch 'input', 'change', and 'blur' events on modified form elements.

lessons.symptom: Phone dial code matches British Indian Ocean Territory (+246) instead of India (+91).
lessons.root_cause: Substring search for 'India' matches territory name before country name.
lessons.fix_rule: Search and match exact dial code string '+91' before fallback to country name.
